messages:
Jordan: Quick heads-up — staging 2.4.1 is green. Readiness window at 18:00 PT. Need someone to press prod. Also saw 2 folks with Okta MFA failures this morning, can someone confirm who currently has 'release-press' rights? :eyes:

Maya: I'm getting Okta push failures after the VPN change. Filed INC-4281. I can't press until MFA is resolved.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: reminder: to trigger prod-release you must hold role `release-press` and have a valid MFA session. See `/tools/release-runner --help` for the gating checks.

Ben: We shouldn't rely on one person. Proposal: grant both release-lead + oncall the press capability. Enforce two-person approval only for rollbacks.

Alice: Current policy (confluence) assigns `release-press` to the Eng Release rota and team leads. Snippet:
```
roles:
  - release-press
  - release-auditor
binding: eng-release-rotation@redwood.com
```
Link: https://confluence.redwood/release-roles

Maya: Can we create short-lived emergency tokens for offboarded folks? Last month Dan was offboarded but still needed a fix and access lagged.

Jordan: We used a breakglass token last month — admin-audit shows it was used by ops-pager and was logged, but it's noisy and risky. Prefer a pre-approved delegation flow instead.

Cameron: What about short-lived delegated sessions from the IDP (Okta) for a `release-delegate` app? Require two approvers (team lead + security). Token auto-expire in 1 hour.

okta-bot: okta-bot: user Maya had 2 failed MFA attempts at 2026-03-20T09:12:03Z. MFA status: unverified.

Ben: For today's push I can be the press if Maya still can't MFA. Jordan, are you oncall at 18:00?

Jordan: Yep, I'll be available. Ben, please verify you can pass MFA now. Quick local check: `rbacctl check --user ben --perm release.press`

Alice: Also request: add an audit hook that posts any breakglass issuance to #incidents and creates an automatic ticket. That'll keep slippage visible.

Jordan: Plan for release: Ben will press if his MFA is green by 17:45. If not, I'll press. If neither of us have valid MFA, we hold the push for 30m and escalate. Rollback power stays with release-lead and requires two approvals.

Maya: ACK. Tagging @security to own the delegated flow design. :thumbsup:

security: Security: noted. We'll draft a delegation playbook (Okta app + two-approver flow + auto-expiry + audit events to #incidents) and circulate by EOW.

Jordan: Thanks — pinging here when Ben verifies MFA so we can lock the window.
